items.name: Strength
items.description: Physical power and resilience. Sets physical wound thresholds and melee weapon DV (Human/Elf/Dwarf 1–4, Ork 1–5, Troll 1–6).

items.name: Agility
items.description: Coordination, precision, and physical speed. Linked to most physical combat, stealth, piloting, and ranged defense Tests (1–4).

items.name: Willpower
items.description: Mental resilience and focus. Sets mental wound thresholds and powers Sorcery, astral combat, and cybercombat (Dwarf 1–5, others 1–4).

items.name: Logic
items.description: Reasoning, technical aptitude, and perception. Linked to Electronics, Cracking, Engineering, Perception, and Hermetic Conjuring (1–4).

items.name: Charisma
items.description: Presence, persuasion, and social pull. Linked to Influence, Network, and Shamanic Conjuring (Elf 1–5, others 1–4).
